cards.headline: Tech investors turn to space data centers after ballot losses
cards.summary: After Democrats won in Texas and other AI infrastructure hot spots, data center enthusiasts looked to low Earth orbit for alternatives, Wired reports. TechCrunch says a bigger clash over data centers may follow the midterms.
cards.why_it_matters: Local opposition to data centers is pushing the AI industry to look for other places to put computing power.

sources.title: The Blue Wave Has Tech Bros Scrambling for Data Centers in Space
After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming

cards.headline: NASA unveils X-70 Fractal experimental aircraft
cards.summary: NASA unveiled the X-70 Fractal at Kennedy Space Center, describing it as a high-performance, adaptable research platform meant to speed development and testing of advanced aviation technologies.
cards.why_it_matters: New X-planes feed technology that can reach commercial and military aviation.

sources.title: NASA Announces X-70 Experimental Aircraft to Advance Flight Research

cards.headline: Warming UK seas could reshape marine ecosystems by 2050
cards.summary: A four-year study warns warming seas around the UK and north-east Atlantic could destabilise marine food webs and weaken ocean health, putting food security at risk by 2050.
cards.why_it_matters: Changes in North Atlantic fisheries and ecosystems can affect seafood supply and prices well beyond Britain.

sources.title: Warming UK seas could ‘fundamentally reshape marine ecosystems’ – report

cards.headline: Researchers say Iron Age ruler Verica was probably a woman
cards.summary: An archaeologist argues that Verica, the British ruler who encouraged Emperor Claudius to invade in AD 43, was probably a woman rather than the man historians assumed. The theory is described as controversial.
cards.why_it_matters: It could change how the origins of Roman Britain are told.

sources.title: British Iron Age ‘king’ who prompted Roman invasion was probably a woman
Historians say King Verica persuaded Rome to invade Britain. But could Verica actually have been a queen?

cards.headline: UK law banning some sexual content draws censorship fears
cards.summary: Adult content creators and free speech advocates warn about a UK law taking effect that bans simulated incest and some depictions of oral sex, Wired reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Online content rules abroad can affect US platforms and creators serving UK users.

sources.title: A New UK Porn Ban Sparks Fears of Unprecedented Sex Censorship

cards.headline: Salvadoran troops deploy to Haiti as technicians go missing
cards.summary: El Salvador's Bukele touted military intervention in Haiti as Salvadoran troops deploy. Haitian police found a vehicle used by four missing Salvadoran technicians.
cards.why_it_matters: Haiti's gang crisis and foreign deployments affect migration and security in the Caribbean near the US.

sources.title: El Salvador’s Bukele touts military intervention in Haiti

cards.headline: Leon Black sues Rep. Robert Garcia over Epstein remarks
cards.summary: Billionaire Leon Black filed a defamation suit against Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., alleging his statements about Black's relationship with Jeffrey Epstein were defamatory. Garcia's response was not in the report.
cards.why_it_matters: The suit tests how far a member of Congress can go in public statements about Epstein-linked figures.

sources.title: Billionaire Leon Black hits Rep. Robert Garcia with defamation suit over Epstein remarks

cards.headline: Trump urges Congress to pass permanent daylight saving time
cards.summary: President Trump called on the Senate to pass the Sunshine Protection Act, which would make daylight saving time permanent, after what he called a ridiculous early sunset. The bill has passed the House.
cards.why_it_matters: It would end twice-yearly clock changes for Americans if enacted.

sources.title: Trump urges Congress to pass daylight saving bill after 'ridiculous' early sunset
Trump pressures Senate on Sunshine Protection Act over ‘ridiculous’ early sunsets

cards.headline: Bob Dylan visits Pope Leo at Vatican
cards.summary: Bob Dylan met Pope Leo at the pope's residence between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief. Leo had quoted Dylan in a preface to a book warning against nuclear rearmament.
cards.why_it_matters: A light moment linking the American pope with one of America's best-known songwriters.

sources.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome

cards.headline: Record 53 red cards shown in Brazil under-20 match
cards.summary: A mass brawl in a match between Uberlandia and Mamore produced 43 red cards for players, eight for coaching staff and two for board members, a Guinness World Record.
cards.why_it_matters: A rare sports oddity with no wider consequence beyond discipline for the clubs.

sources.title: Guinness World Record broken as 53 red cards shown in Brazil under-20 match
